source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed interim financial information 2Q2026 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2026 = year to date). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure p.1-4, review report (Forvis Mazars) p.5. Units differ: the statement of profit or loss (p.8; three-month and six-month columns side by side) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. No PAA business, one portfolio (non-participating). Revenue 2.2.1 p.14 and expenses p.15 (three and six months, both years; the six-month 2569 column is used). CSM roll-forward 2.3.1.2 p.20-21 (30 มิถุนายน 2569); new business 2.3.1.3 p.24. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). The tax line is an expense year to date (2,399,729 Baht: the 1Q2026 credit of 9,895,914 less the second-quarter expense of 12,295,643). RA release uses 2.2.1 (LRC basis, 16,689), not the AOC RA (18,589). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the three-month column of the same statement (p.8).
